name: Christopher Byrne
bio: Christopher launched DC Social Collective in May 2021, when the pandemic had emptied out the young adult social life of the region. With a background in marketing, communications, and event production, he has grown it into one of the most active young adult communities in DC, Maryland, and Virginia. He leads every part of the organization, from the events themselves to venues, sponsors, volunteers, and the brand.

name: Christopher Adams
bio: Christopher grows DSC's partnerships, sponsorships, and membership across the DMV. He comes from real estate, marketing, and community engagement, and works with the leadership team on events, fundraising, and outreach to venues and local organizations.

name: Riley Park
bio: Riley became a brand ambassador in June 2025 after his third DSC event, the Summer Soiree. An educator with a background in linguistics, travel, and project management, he is the person on the floor making sure newcomers meet people.

name: Nico Ozioli
bio: Nico joined as a brand ambassador in July 2026 after a year of coming to DSC nights. A Northern Virginia native with ties to Appalachia and New England, he wants everyone in the room to feel they belong.
